raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: sentinel
  version: 1.0.0

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/sentinel-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 190928f9951af6e94a1f84eefcaed791c28097dd152b88e988906be300451fd2

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - poetry-core
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
  run_constraints:
    - varname >=0.1

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - sentinel
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  summary: Create sentinel objects, akin to None, NotImplemented, Ellipsis
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/eddieantonio/sentinel

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - BubblyOrca
    - mxr-conda
    - zbowling
